# lean-pkg receipt systemd

a lower-tier receipt from a finished systemd --user service unit (run bounded with --run, or its saved properties), its verify log and its stdout seal.

Also spelled: `lean-pkg receipt local` ([all aliases](aliases.md)).

## Usage

```text
lean-pkg receipt systemd --unit U --log PATH --receipt-commit SHA [--stdout PATH]
                         [--stderr PATH] [--properties-file F] [--run]
                         [--memory-max BYTES] [--memory-swap-max BYTES]
                         [--cpu-quota PCT] [--runtime-max SPAN] [--setenv NAME=VALUE]
                         [--require-tools A,B,...] [--contracts-preflight]
                         [--properties-out PATH] [--redact REGEX] [--checker TEXT]
                         [--repo DIR] [--out PATH] [--compress-log] [--append-readme]
                         [--readme-heading TEXT] [--readme-line TEXT] [--tar-sha256 HEX]
                         [--json] [-- CMD ...]
```

## Arguments and flags

| Argument or flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--unit U` | the service unit (`.service` added when absent); job_id becomes systemd-user:&lt;U&gt;:&lt;InvocationID&gt;@&lt;host label&gt; (h- + 12 hex of the host name's SHA-256). Required. |
| `--log PATH` | the raw verify log the unit writes; when it has no `checker:` line, --checker TEXT is required. Required. |
| `--receipt-commit SHA` | the verified commit; must exist in --repo (with --run: the checkout's clean HEAD) (old spelling --commit, kept working). Required. |
| `--stdout PATH` | the unit's stdout file: verify-log-sha256 = sha256(raw log), pre-manifest-sha256 = post-manifest-sha256 = sha256(lake-manifest.json at the commit), optional invocation-id = InvocationID; without it the log must carry its own seal. With --run the unit writes it |
| `--stderr PATH` | the unit's stderr file; must be empty. With --run the unit writes it |
| `--properties-file F` | saved `systemctl --user show U -p Id,LoadState,ActiveState,SubState,Result,InvocationID,ExecMainCode,ExecMainStatus,ExecMainStartTimestamp,ExecMainExitTimestamp,ExecMainStartTimestampMonotonic,ExecMainExitTimestampMonotonic,NRestarts,MemoryPeak,CPUUsageNSec,MemoryMax,MemorySwapMax,CPUQuotaPerSecUSec,RuntimeMaxUSec,OOMPolicy,RemainAfterExit` output, captured before the unit was collected, plus a `Hostname=` line for the host it ran on |
| `--run` | start `-- CMD ...` as the bounded unit U (systemd-run --user, RemainAfterExit, WorkingDirectory=--repo), wait for it, capture its properties before stopping it; --log, --stdout, --stderr must not exist yet. The running lean-pkg's own files must not change during the run (sealed as the receipt key `producer`) |
| `--memory-max BYTES` | --run: MemoryMax (default 8G) |
| `--memory-swap-max BYTES` | --run: MemorySwapMax (default 0, so the memory cap is an OOM kill, not swapping) |
| `--cpu-quota PCT` | --run: CPUQuota (default 400%) |
| `--runtime-max SPAN` | --run: RuntimeMaxSec (default 4h) |
| `--setenv NAME=VALUE` | --run: an extra environment variable for the unit (repeatable; PATH is passed; LAKE_CACHE_DIR=&lt;fresh empty dir&gt; and LAKE_ARTIFACT_CACHE=false unless named here) |
| `--require-tools A,B,...` | --run: executables the command needs (comma-separated, repeatable), each resolved with `type -P` in the unit's PATH before the unit is created; a missing one refuses and nothing is run. The resolved paths and SHA-256 are printed (stderr) and in --json run_tools |
| `--contracts-preflight` | --run: before the unit is created, run the contracts-only diagnostic (`comparator check --contracts-only`) on every comparator configuration of the checkout; a configuration that differs, one whose modules are not built, or a diagnostic that cannot run refuses, and nothing is run or written (docs/comparator.md, Before receipt work) |
| `--properties-out PATH` | --run: where the captured properties go (default &lt;log&gt;.unit.properties) |
| `--redact REGEX` | also replace matches with &lt;redacted&gt; (repeatable); the checkout's path, $HOME and /run/user/N/ are always redacted to &lt;repo&gt;, &lt;HOME&gt;, /run/user/&lt;UID&gt;/ instead |
| `--checker TEXT` | the exact checker command or mode (default: the log's `checker:` line) |
| `--repo DIR` | the package checkout (default: the current directory) |
| `--out PATH` | receipt path (default &lt;repo&gt;/.lean-receipts/&lt;commit12&gt;-systemd-user-&lt;U&gt;-&lt;InvocationID&gt;-&lt;host label&gt;.json); the redacted log is written beside it as &lt;commit12&gt;-systemd-user-&lt;U&gt;-&lt;InvocationID&gt;-&lt;host label&gt;-verify.redacted.log |
| `--compress-log` | write the redacted log as deterministic gzip &lt;...&gt;-verify.redacted.log.gz (level 9, mtime 0, no file name) instead of the plain .log; report_sha256 stays the SHA-256 of the uncompressed log and the receipt gains report_compressed {format: gzip, sha256 of the .gz, bytes = decoded length, not the .gz size}; gate decompresses (bounded) and checks report_sha256. Restore: gzip -dc X.log.gz &gt; X.log. Without it, a log over 90 MiB prints a WARN naming this flag |
| `--append-readme` | append the entry block to README.md beside the receipt (created if absent; an entry already naming the receipt is not repeated) |
| `--readme-heading TEXT` | the entry heading after the short commit (default: lower-tier receipt, systemd unit U) |
| `--readme-line TEXT` | an extra line at the end of the entry block (repeatable) |
| `--tar-sha256 HEX` | the frozen source tarball's SHA-256, named in the entry block |
| `-- CMD` | with --run: the command the unit runs |

## Details

| Form | What it does | Key flags |
|---|---|---|
| `receipt systemd` | the same receipt from a finished systemd --user service unit, for checks run locally in a capped unit; reads and writes no registry. The unit's terminal state comes from one of: `--run -- CMD ...` (lean-pkg starts CMD as the transient unit `U` with `systemd-run --user --unit=U -p RemainAfterExit=yes -p WorkingDirectory=<repo> -p OOMPolicy=stop -p MemoryMax=8G -p MemorySwapMax=0 -p CPUQuota=400% -p RuntimeMaxSec=4h` (`--memory-max`, `--memory-swap-max`, `--cpu-quota`, `--runtime-max` change the caps; a value must be finite), the unit's stdout and stderr going to `--stdout` / `--stderr`, `PATH` and every `--setenv NAME=VALUE` passed; `--contracts-preflight` first runs the contracts-only diagnostic on every comparator configuration of the checkout and refuses, running and writing nothing, when one differs, a configured module is not built or the diagnostic cannot run (`--json` `contracts_preflight` {ok, report}; [details](../receipts.md#contracts-preflight---contracts-preflight)); `--require-tools A,B,...` (repeatable) first resolves each project-declared executable with `type -P` in the unit's `PATH` before the unit is created, prints each resolved path, real path and SHA-256 to stderr (`--json` `run_tools` {required, resolved[] {name, path, realpath, sha256}, missing}) and refuses, running nothing, when one is missing; RemainAfterExit keeps the finished unit loaded, so lean-pkg polls `systemctl --user show U` until it is terminal, captures its properties and this host's name to `--properties-out` (default `<log>.unit.properties`, kept even when the receipt is refused) and only then stops and resets the unit; `--log`, `--stdout`, `--stderr` must not exist yet, and the checkout must be at `--commit` with no tracked change and no untracked file under the package directory before the run and still after it; untracked means listed by `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard`, less `.lean-receipts/`, `.lake/` and the run's own output files; files git ignores are not checked, so they are not bound), `--properties-file F` (`systemctl --user show U -p Id,LoadState,ActiveState,SubState,Result,InvocationID,ExecMainCode,ExecMainStatus,ExecMainStartTimestamp,ExecMainExitTimestamp,ExecMainStartTimestampMonotonic,ExecMainExitTimestampMonotonic,NRestarts,MemoryPeak,CPUUsageNSec,MemoryMax,MemorySwapMax,CPUQuotaPerSecUSec,RuntimeMaxUSec,OOMPolicy,RemainAfterExit` saved before the unit was collected, plus a `Hostname=` line for the host it ran on; exactly these properties are read, `RemainAfterExit` and the resource ones optional, so a capture without `RemainAfterExit` stays valid; `MainPID` is not exported), else `systemctl --user show U` now on this host. Unit checks (every failure listed, any one refuses: exit 1, nothing written to `.lean-receipts`): `LoadState=loaded` (a `--collect` unit read after it finished is not found), `Id` is U (`.service` added), a 32-hex `InvocationID`, terminal (`ActiveState` `failed` or `inactive`, or `active` with `SubState=exited`; `activating`, `running`, `deactivating` refuse) with an exited main process, `Result=success` (`oom-kill`, `timeout`, `signal`, `core-dump`, `exit-code` are named), `ExecMainCode` exited with `ExecMainStatus` 0 (killed or dumped: the signal is named), `NRestarts` 0, a host name. Then every `receipt slurm` check: the stdout seal or the in-log fallback, an optional stdout `invocation-id` line equal to the InvocationID, an empty `--stderr`, the toolchain, Mathlib rev, sorry count, axioms, checker and the optional `commit:`, `job-id:` (the job_id or the InvocationID), `generated-at:` lines, and the public-safety scan after redacting the checkout's absolute path to `<repo>`, `$HOME` to `<HOME>`, `/run/user/N/` to `/run/user/<UID>/` and every `--redact`. `job_id` is `systemd-user:<U>:<InvocationID>@<host label>`, the label being `h-` and the first 12 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the lower-cased host name (the running system's, or the `Hostname=` line's); the host name itself is never written. Writes, beside the receipt and the redacted log, `<c12>-<slug>-unit.properties` (the recognised properties only, in a fixed order, host last as its label; its SHA-256 is the additive receipt key `unit_properties_sha256`), and prints the README entry (unit, invocation, host, Result, exit, runtime, CPU, memory peak, the caps, a `- Unit properties:` line). `--json` as `receipt slurm` with `unit` {id, invocation_id, host, active_state, sub_state, result, exec_main_code, exec_main_status, runtime_usec, cpu_usage_nsec, memory_peak, memory_max, memory_swap_max, cpu_quota_per_sec, runtime_max, remain_after_exit}, `properties` and `ran` in place of `sacct`; usage errors exit 2. A `--run` interrupted while waiting (SIGINT, SIGTERM, SIGHUP) leaves the unit running, keeps its temporary `LAKE_CACHE_DIR` while the unit may still run (removed once it is gone or finished), writes nothing, exits 128 + the signal number and prints the recovery command (the same command without `--run`) with a WARN that recovery skips the source-unchanged-during-the-run check. Before launching, compare every configuration cheaply: [Before receipt work](../comparator.md#before-receipt-work). Details: [Receipts and trust](../receipts.md#a-lower-tier-receipt-from-a-systemd-unit) | `--unit U` `--log PATH` `--commit SHA` `[--properties-file F \| --run [--memory-max B] [--memory-swap-max B] [--cpu-quota PCT] [--runtime-max SPAN] [--setenv NAME=VALUE]... [--require-tools A,B,...]... [--contracts-preflight] [--properties-out PATH] -- CMD ...]` `[--stdout PATH]` `[--stderr PATH]` `[--checker TEXT]` `[--repo DIR]` `[--redact REGEX]...` `[--out PATH]` `[--compress-log]` `[--append-readme [--readme-heading T] [--readme-line T]... [--tar-sha256 HEX]]` `[--json]` |
| `receipt local` | an alias of `receipt systemd`: the same flags, checks and output | as `receipt systemd` |

## Examples

Run a light verify script locally in a capped systemd --user unit and write the same lower-tier receipt as receipt slurm.

```bash
lean-pkg receipt systemd --unit audit-gate --commit "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" \
  --log gate/verify.log --stdout gate/unit.out --stderr gate/unit.err \
  --checker "gate.sh (lake build; #print axioms)" --run -- bash gate.sh gate/verify.log
```
